eyebrow: p5.48xlarge, capped at 512 GPUs, no thrashing
code:
apiVersion: karpenter.sh/v1
kind: NodePool
metadata:
  name: gpu-h100-pool
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      requirements:
        - key: node.kubernetes.io/instance-type
          values: ["p5.48xlarge"]
  limits:
    nvidia.com/gpu: "512"
  disruption:
    consolidationPolicy: WhenEmpty
    consolidateAfter: 10m
caption: Karpenter provisions exactly the GPU instance type a Pending Pod needs, and waits 10 idle minutes before removing a node.
